mapper.select: SELECT P.ID AS posting_id , P.TITLE AS title , C.NAME AS company_name , P.WORK_START_TIME AS work_start_time , P.WORK_END_TIME AS work_end_time FROM POSTING P, POSTER_COMPANY_INFO PCI, COMPANY C, POSTING_APPLICATION PA, POSTING_APP_RESPONSE PAR WHERE PA.ID = PAR.P_APPLICATION_ID AND P.ID = PA.POSTING_ID AND PCI.ID = P.P_COMPANY_INFO_ID AND C.ID = PCI.C_ID AND PAR.STATUS_ID = 100 AND PA.S_ID = #{s_id} UNION SELECT P.ID AS posting_id , P.TITLE AS posting_title , C.NAME AS company_name , P.WORK_START_TIME AS work_start_time , P.WORK_END_TIME AS work_end_time FROM POSTING P, POSTER_COMPANY_INFO PCI, COMPANY C, POSTING_OFFER PO, POSTING_OFF_RESPONSE POR, OPEN_APPLICATION OA WHERE PO.ID = POR.OFFER_ID AND OA.ID = PO.OPEN_APPLICATION_ID AND P.ID = PO.POSTING_ID AND PCI.ID = P.P_COMPANY_INFO_ID AND C.ID = PCI.C_ID AND POR.STATUS_ID = 100 AND OA.S_ID = #{s_id}
